title: Hermes Agent Now Reads Your Documents Locally

yd:
Hermes Agent now reads your documents locally.

If you work with confidential documents from your business or your clients and you run Hermes Agent on your own machine, your data never has to leave it. The reading is done by AnyDoc, an open source PDF analyzer built by the Firecrawl team.
